<translate>
'''Piccolo's House''' is [[Special:MyLanguage/Piccolo|Piccolo]]'s home in the plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Piccolo trains anyone regardless of alignment, heals you and hands out weighted capes.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here ==
</translate>
<translate>
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Piccolo|Piccolo]]''' teaches [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] and five ki attacks, including the Special Beam Cannon and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hellzone Grenade|Hellzone Grenade]]. His services restore your health, ki, stamina and poise ('''Heal me''') and give you a '''Weighted Cape''' ('''Weighted Gear'''). He has no alignment requirement.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it ==
</translate>
<translate>
Piccolo's House generates once per world, in a plains biome. [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistants]] can sell a '''Piccolo's House Map''' at trade tier 2, for 1 Water Bucket and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate piccolo_house}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
Like every master's home, the house can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 2, ''Piccolo Takes Gohan'': find Piccolo's House and talk to Piccolo.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 4, ''Enter the World Tournament'': talk to Piccolo.
</translate>
